activity-report.label: Committee Activity Report
activity-report.description: An account of a committee’s work over a period of time.

amendment.label: Amendment
amendment.description: A proposed change to a measure, draft, or set of rules without a more specific amendment label.

amendment-collection.label: Amendment Packet
amendment-collection.description: A packet that brings together multiple amendments.

amendment-list.label: Amendment List
amendment-list.description: An index of amendments that helps readers identify individual proposals.

appendix.label: Appendix
appendix.description: A section placed after the main text to provide additional detail or reference material.

appropriation-described.label: Appropriations Material
appropriation-described.description: An appropriations measure identified by a description, such as its subject or fiscal year.

appropriation-routed.label: Appropriations Routing
appropriation-routed.description: Appropriations material identified by routing details in the file name, such as the fiscal year or committee code.

attachment.label: Attachment
attachment.description: A separate item included with a primary document.

bill-comparison.label: Comparative Print
bill-comparison.description: A print that compares legislative texts or shows how a proposal would change existing law.

bill-house-amendment.label: House Amendment
bill-house-amendment.description: An amendment identified as a House amendment to a legislative measure.

bill-measure-list.label: List of Bills & Measures
bill-measure-list.description: A list identifying bills, resolutions, or other legislative measures.

bill-named-draft.label: Named Draft Bill
bill-named-draft.description: A draft or committee resolution identified by a name such as Discussion Draft or Committee Rules.

bill-numbered.label: Numbered Bill
bill-numbered.description: A measure identified by both its type and number, such as H.R. 123.

bill-numbered-described.label: Numbered Bill (Described)
bill-numbered-described.description: A numbered measure identified with an additional description in the file name.

bill-preintroduced.label: Pre-Introduced Bill Draft
bill-preintroduced.description: A draft identified as prepared before formal introduction.

bill-suspension-numbered.label: Suspension Bill
bill-suspension-numbered.description: A numbered measure identified for consideration under suspension of the House rules.

bill-titled-draft.label: Titled Draft Bill
bill-titled-draft.description: A draft whose file name uses a title or description before the introduction-stage marker.

bill-unnumbered.label: Unnumbered Bill
bill-unnumbered.description: A legislative file identified without a bill or resolution number.

bill-untyped-draft.label: Discussion Draft Bill
bill-untyped-draft.description: A pre-introduction draft whose file name does not identify its measure type.

bill-untyped-numbered.label: Numbered Legislation
bill-untyped-numbered.description: A numbered measure whose file name does not identify its measure type.

biography.label: Biography
biography.description: An account of a person’s background, career, or qualifications.

brochure.label: Brochure
brochure.description: A short handout that introduces a topic, organization, or program.

budget-views-and-estimates.label: Budget Views & Estimates
budget-views-and-estimates.description: A committee’s views on the budget and estimates for programs within its jurisdiction.

business-meeting.label: Business Meeting / Markup
business-meeting.description: A record or notice of a committee meeting for business such as debating and amending legislation.

chair-mark.label: Chairman's Mark
chair-mark.description: Legislative text proposed by a committee chair as the basis for committee consideration.

committee-amendment.label: Committee Amendment
committee-amendment.description: An amendment identified for committee consideration.

committee-amendment-described.label: Committee Amendment (Described)
committee-amendment-described.description: A committee amendment whose target is identified in words, such as by a draft title.

committee-document.label: Committee Document
committee-document.description: A document identified as committee material without a more specific document label.

committee-enbloc-described.label: En Bloc Amendment (Described)
committee-enbloc-described.description: One or more amendments grouped for committee consideration with their target identified in words.

committee-enbloc-numbered.label: En Bloc Amendment
committee-enbloc-numbered.description: One or more amendments grouped for committee consideration on a numbered measure.

committee-memorandum.label: Committee Memorandum
committee-memorandum.description: A memo that briefs a committee or its members, often before a hearing or business meeting.

committee-print.label: Committee Print
committee-print.description: A document printed for committee use, such as draft legislation or a study.

committee-report.label: Committee Report
committee-report.description: A report identified as a committee report, often accompanying legislation or documenting committee work.

committee-report-part.label: Committee Report Part
committee-report-part.description: One separately identified portion of a committee report.

committee-report-unnumbered.label: Unnumbered Committee Report
committee-report-unnumbered.description: A committee report identified without a report number.

committee-resolution.label: Committee Resolution
committee-resolution.description: A resolution concerning committee business, such as its rules or procedures.

committee-transcript.label: Committee Transcript
committee-transcript.description: A written record of what was said at a committee proceeding.

committee-vote.label: Committee Recorded Vote
committee-vote.description: A record of votes cast on a question before a committee.

conference-legislation-part.label: Conference Legislative Text Part
conference-legislation-part.description: One separately identified portion of legislative text associated with a conference report.

conference-report.label: Conference Report
conference-report.description: A report presenting the agreement reached by House and Senate negotiators.

conference-unnumbered.label: Conference Material
conference-unnumbered.description: Conference report material identified without a report number.

cost-estimate.label: Cost Estimate
cost-estimate.description: An estimate of the costs of legislation, a program, or a proposed action.

crs-report.label: CRS Report
crs-report.description: A research report from the Congressional Research Service.

exhibit.label: Exhibit
exhibit.description: An individual item presented or submitted as part of a proceeding or its record.

exhibit-list.label: Exhibit List
exhibit-list.description: An index of exhibits associated with a proceeding or record.

explanatory-statement.label: Explanatory Statement
explanatory-statement.description: A statement explaining legislative provisions or the intent behind them.

fact-sheet.label: Fact Sheet
fact-sheet.description: A short reference that lists key facts about a topic or proposal.

federal-register-notice.label: Federal Register Notice
federal-register-notice.description: A notice published in the Federal Register.

field-hearing.label: Field Hearing
field-hearing.description: A record or notice of a congressional hearing held outside Washington, D.C.

flyer.label: Flyer
flyer.description: A brief handout publicizing an event, initiative, or message.

gao-report.label: GAO Report
gao-report.description: A report from the Government Accountability Office.

graphic.label: Graphic
graphic.description: A standalone visual, such as a chart, diagram, or illustration.

hearing-charter.label: Hearing Charter
hearing-charter.description: A briefing document that lays out a hearing’s subject and background.

interchamber-amendment.label: Interchamber Amendment
interchamber-amendment.description: An amendment identified as part of an exchange between the House and Senate.

issue-brief.label: Issue Brief
issue-brief.description: A short overview of a policy issue and its context.

legislative-text.label: Legislative Text
legislative-text.description: The wording of a bill, resolution, or other measure identified as legislative text.

letter.label: Letter
letter.description: Correspondence identified as a letter without a more specific letter label.

letter-of-support.label: Letter of Support
letter-of-support.description: A letter expressing support for a measure, nominee, or other subject.

managers-package.label: Manager's Amendment Package
managers-package.description: A package of amendments offered together by the managers of a measure.

mark-description.label: Description of the Chairman's Mark
mark-description.description: A document explaining the contents or provisions of a committee chair’s proposed text.

mark-modification.label: Modification to the Chairman's Mark
mark-modification.description: A proposed change to the legislative text offered by a committee chair.

meeting-notice.label: Meeting Notice
meeting-notice.description: An announcement of a specific meeting or hearing, often giving the date, time, and subject.

meeting-results.label: Markup / Meeting Results
meeting-results.description: A record of actions or decisions from a committee meeting or markup.

meeting-support.label: Meeting Support Document
meeting-support.description: Background or reference material accompanying a meeting or hearing.

member-roster.label: Committee Roster
member-roster.description: A list of the legislators who serve on a committee or subcommittee.

member-statement.label: Member Statement
member-statement.description: A statement attributed to a member of Congress.

motion.label: Motion
motion.description: A proposal asking a committee or chamber to take a particular action.

nomination.label: Nomination
nomination.description: A record of, or material identified with, a nomination for an appointment.

notice.label: Notice
notice.description: An announcement or notification without a more specific notice label.

opening-remarks.label: Opening Remarks
opening-remarks.description: Comments identified as introductory remarks at a proceeding.

opening-statement.label: Opening Statement
opening-statement.description: A statement identified as opening a hearing or other proceeding.

oversight-plan.label: Oversight Plan
oversight-plan.description: A committee’s plan for reviewing programs, agencies, or implementation of laws.

pamphlet.label: Pamphlet
pamphlet.description: A short booklet that explains a topic or provides reference information.

panel-discussion.label: Panel Discussion
panel-discussion.description: A record or notice of a discussion among a group of panelists.

panelist-list.label: Panelist List
panelist-list.description: A list identifying the people on a panel.

participant-list.label: Participant List
participant-list.description: A list identifying participants in a meeting or event.

press-release.label: Press Release
press-release.description: An announcement prepared for public or media distribution.

public-law.label: Public Law
public-law.description: A measure enacted into law and identified as a public law.

published-hearing.label: Published Hearing
published-hearing.description: A published record of a congressional hearing that may include proceedings and submitted material.

published-print.label: Published Committee Print
published-print.description: A committee print identified in a congressional publication collection.

published-report.label: Published Committee Report
published-report.description: A committee report identified in a congressional publication collection.

questionnaire.label: Questionnaire
questionnaire.description: A form or set of prompts used to collect written information.

questions-for-record.label: Questions for the Record
questions-for-record.description: Written questions submitted for inclusion in a hearing record, often after the hearing.

questions-for-record-response.label: Responses to Questions for the Record
questions-for-record-response.description: Written answers to questions submitted for the hearing record.

remarks.label: Remarks
remarks.description: Comments identified as remarks without a more specific remarks label.

report.label: Report
report.description: A document that presents findings or describes work without a more specific report label.

response.label: Response
response.description: A written reply without a more specific response label.

revenue-estimate.label: Revenue Estimate
revenue-estimate.description: An estimate of how a proposal would affect government revenues.

rules-memorandum.label: Rules Committee Memorandum
rules-memorandum.description: A memorandum identified with House Rules Committee business.

section-by-section.label: Section-by-Section Summary
section-by-section.description: A summary that explains a measure in the order of its sections.

slides.label: Presentation Slides
slides.description: Visual pages prepared for a presentation or briefing.

staff-report.label: Staff Report
staff-report.description: A report attributed to committee or other congressional staff.

statement.label: Statement
statement.description: A written or prepared statement without a more specific statement label.

subpoena.label: Subpoena
subpoena.description: A formal demand to provide records, testimony, or both.

summary.label: Summary
summary.description: A condensed account of a measure, document, or proceeding.

supporting-material.label: Supporting Material
supporting-material.description: Material supplied as background or evidence for another document or proceeding.

tally-sheet.label: Vote Tally Sheet
tally-sheet.description: A sheet recording or totaling votes on a question.

testimony.label: Witness Testimony
testimony.description: A witness’s account or evidence offered to a congressional committee.

testimony-disclosure.label: Truth in Testimony Disclosure
testimony-disclosure.description: A witness disclosure form covering matters such as relevant funding and affiliations.

transcript.label: Transcript
transcript.description: A written record of spoken proceedings without a more specific transcript label.

treaty-document.label: Treaty Document
treaty-document.description: A document concerning a treaty submitted to the Senate for advice and consent.

vote-record.label: Vote Record
vote-record.description: A document recording votes cast or the result of a vote.

witness-biography.label: Witness Biography
witness-biography.description: An account of the background or qualifications of a congressional witness.

witness-list.label: Witness List
witness-list.description: A list identifying witnesses for a hearing.

witness-statement.label: Witness Statement
witness-statement.description: A written statement attributed to a witness and submitted for a congressional proceeding.

witness-support.label: Witness Supporting Material
witness-support.description: Supporting material associated with a witness or their statement.

amendment.label: Amendment
amendment.description: Proposed changes to measures, drafts, or rules, including individual amendments and amendment packets.

biography.label: Biography
biography.description: Accounts of people’s backgrounds or qualifications, including witness biographies.

disclosure.label: Disclosure
disclosure.description: Documents that disclose information, including witnesses’ Truth in Testimony forms.

exhibit.label: Exhibit
exhibit.description: Individual exhibits and packets of exhibits presented or submitted for the record.

legislation.label: Legislation
legislation.description: Legislative texts and related materials, including drafts, numbered measures, appropriations materials, and public laws.

letter.label: Letter
letter.description: Correspondence, including letters that express support for a measure, nominee, or other subject.

list.label: List
list.description: Lists identifying people or documents, including witness lists, committee rosters, and lists of measures.

memorandum.label: Memorandum
memorandum.description: Memos, including briefings prepared for committee business.

notice.label: Notice
notice.description: Announcements, including notices of meetings and hearings.

print.label: Print
print.description: Committee prints, including legislative drafts and studies prepared for committee use.

questions-and-answers.label: Questions and Answers
questions-and-answers.description: Questionnaires, written questions for the hearing record, and responses to those questions.

remarks.label: Remarks
remarks.description: Comments identified as remarks, including comments that open a proceeding.

report.label: Report
report.description: Reports and related report materials, including committee and conference reports.

statement.label: Statement
statement.description: Prepared statements and testimony, including opening statements and submissions by members or witnesses.

supporting-material.label: Supporting Material
supporting-material.description: Background or evidence associated with documents, meetings, or witnesses.

transcript.label: Transcript
transcript.description: Written records of spoken proceedings, including committee transcripts.

vote-record.label: Vote Record
vote-record.description: Documents that record votes cast or vote totals, including committee vote records and tally sheets.
